value.description: Amount in base units, decimal (e.g. 5000000 = 5 USDC at 6 decimals)
value.name: value

from.description: Payer address (default: the wallet's selected EVM account)
from.name: from

domain-version.name: domain-version

purpose.description: Stated purpose — forwarded to the gate as the agent request
purpose.name: purpose

policy.description: Path to the operator policy JSON (else LIGIS_WALLET_POLICY / _FILE)
policy.name: policy

mandate-max-usd.name: mandate-max-usd

mandate-max-seconds.name: mandate-max-seconds

mandate-capability.name: mandate-capability
